name: Evelyn
description: An old, cunning vampire of the Maestros who trades favors, and who supplies Anhelo with the Old Capennan Warrior.

timeline.summary: Anhelo sends Fiero an invitation to a private museum tour and asks Evelyn for a favor, agreeing to owe her.
